clean_task.detail: An independently authored CSR SpMM task ran through the typed container Provider in the digest-pinned gcc 13.2.0 image. The generated matrix passed CSR structural validation, the register-blocked candidate reproduced its own baseline exactly, undefined-behaviour/bounds and address sanitizer runs passed, and four alternating warm replays beat the baseline by 4.004x or more against a 1.05x gate. No imported attachment executed.
